symptom: Recrues : la date de début d'essai de certaines recrues repart régulièrement à aujourd'hui, alors qu'elles n'ont pas quitté la guilde.
code:
35: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  36: local lastScan = 0
  37: local function ScanTrials()
  38:     if not db or db.trialRank == "" or not W.IsInGuild() or GetTime() - lastScan < 30 then return end
  39:     lastScan = GetTime()
  40:     local members = W.GuildMembers()
  41:     if #members == 0 then return end
  42:     local now, at = time(), {}
  43:     for _, m in ipairs(members) do
  44:         if m.rank == db.trialRank then
  45:             local k = m.full:lower()
  46:             at[k] = true

  48:         end
  49:     end
  50:     for k in pairs(db.trials) do

  52:     end
  53: end
  54: 
  55: local UI = {}

fix:
diff --git a/WarLegendRaidTool/Roster.lua b/WarLegendRaidTool/Roster.lua
index 19ed6e2..26e4838 100644
--- a/WarLegendRaidTool/Roster.lua
+++ b/WarLegendRaidTool/Roster.lua
@@ -40,14 +40,14 @@ local function ScanTrials()
     local members = W.GuildMembers()
     if #members == 0 then return end
-    local now, at = time(), {}
+    local now, rankOf = time(), {}
     for _, m in ipairs(members) do
-        if m.rank == db.trialRank then
-            local k = m.full:lower()
-            at[k] = true
-            if not db.trials[k] then db.trials[k] = now end
-        end
+        local k = m.full:lower()
+        rankOf[k] = m.rank
+        if m.rank == db.trialRank and not db.trials[k] then db.trials[k] = now end
     end
-    for k in pairs(db.trials) do
-        if not at[k] then db.trials[k] = nil end -- promoted or gone
+    -- promoted: forgotten. Not in the roster: kept (the roster can list online members only on Classic),
+    -- forgotten after 6 months
+    for k, since in pairs(db.trials) do
+        if (rankOf[k] and rankOf[k] ~= db.trialRank) or now - since > 180 * 86400 then db.trials[k] = nil end
     end
 end
